package fixture

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

// A local function alias is still a direct reference to tenant.FromContext.
// The guard must reject the reference even though the eventual call's callee
// is an identifier rather than a selector expression.
func badHandlerFunctionAlias(ctx context.Context) (string, string, error) {
	fromContext := tenant.FromContext
	tenantID, err := fromContext(ctx)
	return tenantID, "actor", err
}
